figure_description: A horizontal line segment has endpoints labeled P on the left and Q on the right. A point R lies on the line segment between P and Q. A ray labeled with endpoint S extends upward and to the left from R. The angle PRS is marked with an arc and labeled "2x". The adjacent angle SRQ is marked with an arc and labeled "7x".
